@@U04398@@
Are you 鲍西丝? The very same, who when I was near to death brought food to nourish me in my need?

@@U04399@@
(Enter PHILOMEN.)

@@U04400@@
And you—yourre 菲勒蒙, 菲勒蒙 who rescued my treasure from the sea. It was you who lit the beacon fire and sounded the little silver bell; you and 鲍西丝 who rescued me from that catastrophe. But now let me walk out onto the dunes, and see again the endless, boundless sea. Let me kneel and pray. I’m deeply moved.

@@U04401@@
(He walks out onto the dune.)

@@U04403@@
(To 鲍西丝.)

@@U04404@@
Hurry, lay the table in the garden! Where the flowers are nicest! Let him have his look. What a fright he'll take! He wont believe his eyes!

@@U04405@@
(Coming up beside the WANDERER.)

@@U04406@@
The place that treated you so fiercely, mountains of wild and foaming waves, is a garden now, a paradise. I was no stripling then, not able to help as I could have once, no strength in me even then, but I watched, watched and saw the water pushed
translation:
@@U04398@@
你是鲍西丝吗？同样的，谁在我快要死的时候送来食物来滋润我的需要呢？

@@U04399@@
（菲洛门上。）

@@U04400@@
而你——你是菲勒蒙，从海上救起我的宝藏的菲勒蒙。是你点燃了烽火，敲响了小银铃；你和鲍西丝把我从这场灾难中救了出来。但现在让我走到沙丘上，再次看到一望无际、无边无际的大海。让我跪下来祈祷。我深受感动。

@@U04401@@
（他走到沙丘上。）

@@U04403@@
（致鲍西丝。）

@@U04404@@
快点，把桌子放在花园里！哪里的花最好看！让他看看。他会受到多么大的惊吓啊！他不敢相信自己的眼睛！

@@U04405@@
（来到流浪者身边。）

@@U04406@@
曾经对你如此严厉的地方，狂野的山脉和泡沫的波浪，现在是一个花园，一个天堂。那时我还不是小伙子，无法像以前那样提供帮助，即使那时我也没有力量，但我看着，看着，看到水被推开
